verification_candidates.claim_text: Plants are loaded with things that are designed to hurt humans.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Plants are loaded with things that are designed to. Hurt us
verification_candidates.rationale: This contested claim about plant defenses is the core of the carnivore anti-plant argument and is being checked against evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Some plant anti-nutrients can interfere with the body absorbing certain nutrients.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: They can interfere with us absorbing certain nutrients
verification_candidates.rationale: Claims about anti-nutrients blocking absorption are checkable and underpin dietary advice.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Most plant anti-nutrients either break down when cooked, are present in very small doses, or do not matter much in a generally healthy, varied diet.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: most of these things either break down when they're cooked, or they're they're in very small doses, or they just don't matter that much
verification_candidates.rationale: The claim that cooking and dose neutralize plant anti-nutrients is checkable and answers the carnivore argument.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Spinach and carrots are not toxic.
verification_candidates.rationale: A simple checkable claim used to rebut the idea that common vegetables are poisonous.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A case series found that people with IBD who switched to a vegan diet had their IBD clear up.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I also found a case series where people with IBD switched to a vegan diet
verification_candidates.rationale: The existence and outcome of this case series is checkable and is used as evidence against a single IBD diet.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There is probably no single IBD diet that works for everyone.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: there's probably no one IBD diet to heal them all
verification_candidates.rationale: A testable claim about whether any universal diet treats IBD.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The carnivore diet cures arthritis, psoriasis, and a lot of autoimmune conditions.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: people talk about stuff like the carnivore diet curing arthritis, psoriasis, a lot of autoimmune stuff, actually

verification_candidates.claim_text: The carnivore diet helps people with brain fog.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: people will also say it helps them with brain fog

verification_candidates.evidence_quote: there is some evidence that for some people, going into ketosis tamps down their inflammation
